what_happened: The retry job "trim change/study verifier and study producer prompts safely" (prompts) was rejected. It is the retry of 20261024-232057-r4pj, which was rejected for the same D166 entry. The verifier marked 1 of 7 acceptance criteria unmet: docs/decisions.md must have a new entry that lists each removed passage or group with its file and the reason it was removable, and makes no claim beyond what the diff and test run show. It gave one major finding: the D166 entry does not say why each removed passage could be removed, and it leaves some removals out. No check failed. The prompt trimming itself was not faulted this time. Only the decision entry that documents it was incomplete.
cause: The decision entry is a prose summary written by the producer after the edit. Nothing derives the list of removed passages from the diff, and nothing checks that each removal has a file and a reason. The retry's reading did not carry over the earlier finding (that D166's claims were false and incomplete) as a specific item to verify. The criterion that a reader can match each bullet to the diff is judged only by the final verifier, so the gap in the entry surfaces at the end. The same entry failed on both attempts.
prevention: Add a code check that runs before the verifier on any job whose criteria require a removal log. It lists the removed hunks per file from the diff. It requires that every hunk falls under a bullet in the new decisions.md entry, and that every bullet has a stated reason. It fails with the unmatched hunks named. On a retry, the previous verifier finding should be carried into the reading as an explicit checked item.
proposed_request: Retry of 20261108-004822-e16j: fix the D166 entry in docs/decisions.md for the verifier and study producer prompt trim. Outcome: D166 lists every passage removed from the prompts, with its file and a one-line reason it was removable (repetition, or backed by no rule). A reader can match each bullet to a hunk in the diff, and no hunk is left without a bullet. D166 makes no claim about tests or brief contents beyond what the diff and the test run show. Only docs/decisions.md may change, unless the diff shows a prompt edit must be restored. Acceptance: (1) for each removed hunk in the prompt diff there is exactly one bullet naming the file and the reason; (2) the entry contains no claim about tests that the recorded test run does not show; (3) cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy and cargo test pass, with evidence citing the commands that ran.
